note: Held-out multi-turn set: written and committed before any run on it. Context questions are asked first, in the same conversation; the case is scored on the answer to 'question'. 'tools_required_in_conversation' accepts the tool in any turn, so an answer that reuses an earlier tool result is judged on its content (the v4 F5/F9 point). 'tools_required' still means the final turn, for follow-ups that change a parameter, where reusing the old result would be wrong. Do not edit after the first recorded run.

context: My rent is 25% below the average for similar flats. How much can my landlord raise it when I renew?

cases.note: Band (a): up to 10% below average, no increase. The first turn's answer is 10% (band c).
